# ENT Care Clinic — Dr. Aashima Chopra

Official website of ENT Care Clinic in Greater Kailash I, New Delhi, and Dr. Aashima Chopra, MBBS, DNB (ENT) Gold Medallist, MNAMS.

## Clinic identity

- Doctor: Dr. Aashima Chopra
- Specialty: Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT / Otorhinolaryngology)
- Clinic: ENT Care Clinic
- Location: 145, W Block, Greater Kailash I, New Delhi 110048, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 99992 02000
- Website: https://nachopraent.com/

## Core services

- Adult and paediatric ENT consultation
- Functional endoscopic sinus surgery (FESS)
- Endoscopic ear surgery
- Ossiculoplasty and mastoidectomy
- Allergy assessment and skin prick testing
- Sublingual immunotherapy (SLIT) for selected allergies
- Voice and hoarseness assessment
- Micro-laryngoscopic surgery (MLS) for selected conditions
- Snoring and obstructive sleep apnoea assessment
- Polysomnography (PSG) sleep study
